goal: Prevent periodic wallet rebroadcasts from leaking a node IP address when private broadcast is enabled
Keep unconfirmed wallet transactions on private broadcast paths instead of falling back to public peers
agreement: Blocking objection: dependent transactions like CPFP stall without package relay support (achow101)
Nonblocking objection: dust sent to wallet addresses still triggers public rebroadcasts (mzumsande)
Support: simplifies rebroadcast without tracking per-transaction broadcast state (w0xlt)
Concept approval: necessary to honor private broadcast during wallet rebroadcasting (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because periodic rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast settings every 12 to 36 hours
Prevents deanonymizing the node IP address across regular peer connections

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because unconfirmed wallet transaction resubmissions undermine user privacy configurations
Protects wallet users who enabled private broadcasting from unintended origin exposure
